corrected_content.problem: Simplify the trigonometric expression $\frac{\cos^{2} θ\sin^{2} θ + \sin^{4} θ}{\cos θ\sin θ}$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
On the domain of the original fraction,
$$\frac{\cos^2\theta\sin^2\theta+\sin^4\theta}{\cos\theta\sin\theta}=\frac{\sin^2\theta(\cos^2\theta+\sin^2\theta)}{\cos\theta\sin\theta}=\tan\theta.$$
